title: Billionaires catalog: the individuals behind the AI / Digital-ID / academia / surveillance networks - wealth source -> foundations, stakes, boards, elite forums
source: Public record: company founding/leadership; foundation founding; board memberships; Forbes/Bloomberg wealth-source attribution; NSCAI + Defense Innovation Board (Schmidt); Open Philanthropy funding (Moskovitz). Catalog layer (#208). Structural overlay; edges graded. Person nodes carry Persons-tab dossiers (backlink via orgs). HONESTY: wealth source + board/foundation ties are FACT; imputing coordinated intent across these (often rival) individuals is avoided.

edges.notes: Gates co-founded Microsoft (1975) - the wealth source behind the Gates Foundation + his climate/health/ag investments (fact).
The Gates (ex-Gates-Melinda) Foundation is his primary influence vehicle - global health, digital-ID/financial-inclusion, US education (fact); wires the billionaire layer to the foundations block.
Zuckerberg founded + controls Meta (Facebook/Instagram/WhatsApp) via dual-class supervoting shares - near-total control of a ~3B-user platform (fact).
CZI is his Meta-wealth philanthropy LLC (science/education) - wiring him to the foundations block (fact).
Bezos founded Amazon (1994) - wealth source behind Blue Origin, the Washington Post, and Bezos Earth Fund; Amazon's AWS is core cloud infrastructure incl. for government/IC (fact).
Andreessen (Netscape) co-founded Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) - the mega-VC pushing crypto, AI, defense-tech, and the Network State/techno-optimist ideology (fact).
Andreessen's 'Techno-Optimist Manifesto' + a16z's backing of the Network State idea make him a leading voice of the exit/techno-libertarian cluster (fact of advocacy).
Schmidt was Google/Alphabet CEO then Executive Chairman - the wealth + network source for his later defense-AI role (fact).
Schmidt chaired the DoD Defense Innovation Board + the National Security Commission on AI (NSCAI) - the marquee tech-billionaire-to-national-security-AI bridge; also funds defense-tech (fact).
Huang co-founded + leads NVIDIA - the chokepoint AI-chip vendor at the center of the compute-capital core (fact); the newest member of the centibillionaire tier via the AI boom.
Luckey (Oculus, sold to Facebook) founded Anduril - the Founders-Fund-backed defense-autonomy prime; wires the billionaire layer to the defense-tech/IQT cluster (fact).

Hoffman (LinkedIn co-founder; PayPal Mafia; Greylock) is a co-principal of the Dialog forum (with Thiel) - though a Democratic mega-donor, the political mirror image of Thiel within the same elite network (fact).
Hoffman was an early OpenAI board member + funder (later stepped off amid Microsoft-conflict concerns) - a node linking the PayPal Mafia to frontier AI governance (fact).

Moskovitz (Facebook co-founder; Asana) + Cari Tuna fund Open Philanthropy - the primary money engine of Effective Altruism + AI-safety grantmaking (fact); wires the billionaire layer to the foundations/EA block.
Via Open Phil + Good Ventures, Moskovitz is EA's largest funder - the individual behind much of the AI-safety philanthropy shaping OpenAI/Anthropic governance (fact).
Thiel co-founded the Dialog forum - completing the founder linkage to the elite-forum block (#189-195) (fact).
Thiel is the central node of the PayPal Mafia - wiring the billionaire layer to the elite-groups block (fact).
Musk (X.com/PayPal) -> SpaceX/Tesla/xAI/X/Neuralink - the highest-net-worth member of the network (fact).
Hoffman is a PayPal-Mafia member (COO) - the Democratic-donor counterpart to Thiel within the same alumni network (fact).
Schmidt is a longtime Davos/WEF + CFR-adjacent figure - typical of the tech-billionaire presence in the establishment-convening layer (fact of participation).
Gates is a perennial Davos participant + WEF partner (via the foundation) - among the most prominent philanthropist-attendees (fact).
